'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrines}} named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine}}, which is covered in another article.

These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qid=Q272993}}, the deity of {{ill|Gion Faith|en|Gion cult|qid=Q11588425|lt=Gion faith}}. Before the {{ill|Shinbutsu bunri|ja|神仏分離令|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to QID FIXED|qid=Q1970535|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with {{ill|Gozu Tennō|en|Gozu Tennō|qid=Q11570247|lt=Gozu Tennō}}.

Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion shrines|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine}}, {{ill|Tsushima Shrine|en|Tsushima Shrine|qid=Q705136|lt=Tsushima Shrines}}, {{ill|Yakumo shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11391847}}, {{ill|Yaegaki Shrine|en|Yaegaki Shrine|qid=Q3571285|lt=Yaegaki Shrines}}, {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11664499}}, and {{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|en|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|qid=Q703633|lt=Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)}}.

Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine {{ill|Yasakatome|en|Yasakatome|qid=Q9150392|lt=Yasakatome-no-Kami}}.

== Main Shrine ==
[[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|en|Yasaka Shrine|qid=Q692714|lt=Yasaka Shrine}}, one of the head shrines]]
* '''{{ill|Yasaka Shrine|en|Yasaka Shrine|qid=Q692714|lt=Yasaka Shrine}}''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|感神院祇園社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q692714}} under {{ill|Tiantai|en|Tiantai|qid=Q668188|lt=Tendai Buddhism}} and {{ill|Mount Hiei|en|Mount Hiei|qid=Q748040|lt=Mount Hiei}} until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.

* ''' {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|疫神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}.
'''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine}}.

These shrines are part of {{ill|Gion Faith|en|Gion cult|qid=Q11588425|lt=Gion faith}}, venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qid=Q272993}} (formerly identified with {{ill|Gozu Tennō|en|Gozu Tennō|qid=Q11570247|lt=Gozu Tennō}} before the {{ill|Shinbutsu bunri|en|Shinbutsu bunri|qid=Q1970535|lt=Shinbutsu Bunri}} decree).

Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion shrines|ja|祇園神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine|en|Hiromine Shrine|qid=Q11484399|lt=Hiromine Shrine}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine}}, {{ill|Tsushima Shrine|en|Tsushima Shrine|qid=Q705136|lt=Tsushima Shrine}}<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo shrine|ja|八雲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11391847}}, {{ill|Yaegaki Shrine|en|Yaegaki Shrine|qid=Q3571285|lt=Yaegaki Shrine}}, {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine}}, and {{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|en|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|qid=Q703633|lt=Hikawa Shrine}}<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.

However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine {{ill|Yasakatome|en|Yasakatome|qid=Q9150392|lt=Yasakatome-no-Kami}} instead.

The {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|en|Yasaka Shrine|qid=Q692714|lt=Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)}} in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|感神院祇園社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q692714}} of the {{ill|Tiantai|en|Tiantai|qid=Q668188|lt=Tendai sect}}, affiliated with {{ill|Mount Hiei|en|Mount Hiei|qid=Q748040|lt=Mount Hiei}}.

[[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|{{ill|Yasaka Shrine|en|Yasaka Shrine|qid=Q692714|lt=Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)}} (One of the Head Shrines)]]
